RootCause: CSS stacking context isolation prevented inheritance of parent background-clip

Description: DeferredSection lacks a local ErrorBoundary. When dynamic chunk loading fails due to network drop during scroll, the rejection bubbles to RouteErrorBoundary and crashes the page, unmounting the working Hero
RootCause: No local error isolation around lazy-loaded sections
Evidence: scripts/test-local-network-torture.cjs: Hero survives offline scroll and auto-recovers

Description: Invisible typewriter text on accent gradient lines in mobile viewports
RootCause: Intermediate unstyled span broke CSS inheritance; 1ms step-end animation stalled in hidden state

Description: Sequence timing broken for multi-line hero title animations
RootCause: Each line calculated its own sequence gap without accumulating duration of preceding lines

Description: Hero title animations frozen or skipped on initial load
RootCause: data-title-fit-measuring forced animation: none and settleTitleEffects finished animations immediately

Description: GPU slowdown and forced reflow on Meta Apps hero receipt
RootCause: Double drop-shadow on 82-point polygon and sync getBoundingClientRect() inside layout effect

Description: Excessive below-the-fold component mounting on initial load
RootCause: rootMargin was fixed at 1200px triggering 4 sections to mount at once

Description: Non-canonical route links caused 308 redirects on edge

RootCause: navHeight measured document.querySelector inside every requestAnimationFrame tick
Evidence: navHeight measured once before RAF loop

Description: DOM thrashing on 12 binary search iterations for title pre-fit
RootCause: Attribute data-title-fit-measuring toggled inside every iteration of binary search
Evidence: Attribute set once before binary search and removed once after

Description: Non-consenting marketing visitors triggered D1 outbox and Meta CAPI calls

Description: Risk of Meta CAPI transmission without explicit marketing consent

Description: Admin 2FA could be bypassed with setup action and master password alone
